title: AI Powered Research Recommender
subtitle: AI · Research
heroImageAlt: AI recommendation interface for academic research

overview.label: Story
overview.heading: Overview
overview.body: Intelligent recommendation engine combining NLP and adaptive UX to surface contextually relevant academic research — with a conversational interface and personalized discovery flows.

problem.label: Problem
problem.heading: Why this needed to exist
problem.body: Researchers drown in fragmented academic sources; generic search surfaces irrelevant papers and breaks exploratory flow.

approach.label: Approach
approach.heading: How the work got done
approach.body: Built an NLP-driven recommender with adaptive UX and a conversational interface. Intent-aware ranking personalizes discovery by context, not just keywords.

outcomes.label: Outcomes
outcomes.heading: What changed once it shipped
outcomes.body: Faster, more relevant discovery with reduced cognitive load — users follow thread-like explorations instead of fragmented searches.

credits.label: Credits
credits.heading: One last thing
credits.body: Intelligent recommendation engine combining NLP and adaptive UX to surface contextually relevant academic research — with a conversational interface and personalized discovery flows.
